searchText: What are the current EVM-384 EIP and BLS Precompile EIP numbers? EIP-2537 for BLS precompile. afaik evm384 has no eip yet, it may be published soon. Perhaps we should break this EIP up into smaller EIPs so we can get some actually integrated. From the above, it sounds like ETH2 will need `BLS12_PAIRING`, `BLS12_MAP_FP_TO_G1`, `BLS12_MAP_FP2_TO_G2`. (if I'm understanding correctly)
